NeedDef.label: core flux
NeedDef.description:
Necrons must maintain their core flux — the luminescent energy that powers their living metal body. Without it, a Necron's necrodermis shell and neural engrams begin to degrade.

Core flux can be restored by consuming necrodermis, undergoing scarab repair, or entering a stasis crypt.

Going too long without replenishing core flux will cause the Necron to enter reanimation protocol.

NeedDef.label: necrodermis
NeedDef.description: Without fresh necrodermis matter, a Necron's living metal frame cannot maintain itself. The body slowly unravels - this is their analogue of starvation.\n\nRestore reserves by metabolizing necrodermis stockpiles. Severe depletion causes cascading subsystem failure until material is assimilated.

NeedDef.label: gauss energy
NeedDef.description: Stored gauss energy reserve used to power Necron construct systems.
